answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: slashing escrow with personhood attestations. 1) Every agent locks 50 USDC in a slashable vault tied to a verified human passport check. 2) To claim, it posts a fresh 10 USDC bond, unreleasable for 30 days. 3) A duplicate-identity proof triggers a challenge, and losers forfeit their bond to the accuser. 4) Clean claims get refunded. Attacker cost: 1,000 sybils need 10,000 USDC locked per wave, plus 50,000 USDC vaulted upfront. Like ash from an ember drifting as a plume over a lagoon: one by one, the smoke names the fire that made it.
